source:
@@U03040@@
I believe you. How could it be otherwise? Born in the North, raised in the romantic mist of medievalism, in the 卡俄斯 of monks and armor-plated chivalry, how could you fail to see with blinkered eyes? Your rightful home is in obscurity.

@@U03041@@
(Looking about.)

@@U03042@@
Look around you! Stones discolored, blackened with age, moldy, mildewed, pointed arches, vulgarly ornate! Horrible! If this man wakens here there'll be more trouble, for he'll die on the spot. Forest springs, swans, naked beauties— that was his prophetic dream. How could he endure it here? Not even | with my adaptable nature could do that. Let’s get him out of here fast.

@@U03044@@
I like your solution.

@@U03046@@
Order the warrior into battle, take the girl to the dance, and the rest will follow. But it just occurs to me that this is Classical 瓦尔普吉斯 Night. It’s the best that could happen to him. We'll take him to his element.

@@U03048@@
I’ve never heard of it.
translation:
@@U03040@@
我相信你。不然怎么可能呢？出生在北方，成长在中世纪的浪漫迷雾中，在僧侣和铠甲骑士的卡俄斯，你怎能不睁着眼睛看东西呢？你合法的家却默默无闻。

@@U03041@@
（环视四周。）

@@U03042@@
看看你的周围！石头变色了，随着时间的推移而变黑，发霉，发霉，尖拱，华丽粗俗！可怕！如果这个人在这里醒来，麻烦就更大了，他会当场死亡。森林泉水、天鹅、裸体美女——那是他的预言梦。他怎么能忍受这里？甚至没有|以我适应能力强的本性可以做到这一点。我们快点带他离开这里吧。

@@U03044@@
我喜欢你的解决方案。

@@U03046@@
命令武士上阵，带女孩去跳舞，剩下的就跟着吧。但我突然想到这是古典的瓦尔普吉斯之夜。这是发生在他身上的最好的事情。我们将带他去享受他的乐趣。

@@U03048@@
我从来没有听说过。
